LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT CHASE HOME FINANCE LLC'S DEMURRER TO 1ST AMENDED COMPLAINT IS SUSTAINED WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND TO COMPLY WITH CRC 2.112(1) AS TO SECTION 2923.6 CLAIM, DEMURRER IS SUSTAINED WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND BECAUSE IT CREATES NO PRIVATE RIGHT OF ACTION AND AS TO SECTION 1572 CLAIM, IT IS SUSTAINED WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND BECAUSE THE CLAIM IS DUPLICATIVE OF ANY FRAUD CLAIM. AS TO SECTION 2923.5 CLAIM, THE DEMURRER WOULD BE OVERRULED GIVEN PLAINTIFF'S ALLEGATION THAT HE WAS NOT CONTACTED AS REQUIRED. AS TO ALL OTHER CLAIMS, THE DEMURRER IS ALSO SUSTAINED WITH LEAVE TO AMEND TO PLEAD THE BREACHED TERMS OF ANY ENFORCEABLE CONTRACT WITH DEFENDANTS THAT IS MORE THAN MERELY AN AGREEMENT TO NEGOTIATE, TO PLEAD THE ALLEGED INTENTIONAL TORT, AND TO PLEAD WITH SPECIFICITY ANY ALLEGED MISREPRESENTATION AND HOW PLAINTIFF HAS REASONABLY RELIED ON IT TO HIS DETRIMENT. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J. BUSCH, REPORTER: NICCI RODICH, CSR # 11604
